# Fixture provenance

These are Synthetic, documented-format command outputs, not recorded hardware results.
Chrony CSV layout follows official `chrony` tags 4.2/4.5 `client.c` (tracking 14 fields,
sources 10, sourcestats 8). LinuxPTP response layout follows upstream `pmc.c`.
`ethtool -T` uses standard ethtool headings. Documentation source links are in
`docs/research.md`. Numeric values are injected test data only.
